clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Coverage
clauses.text: We insure for direct physical loss to “covered equipment” on the “residence premises” caused by an “equipment breakdown”, and for direct physical loss to other property covered under Section I caused by an “equipment breakdown”.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Definitions
clauses.text: “Equipment breakdown” means a sudden and accidental failure of “covered equipment” that manifests itself by physical damage requiring repair or replacement, resulting from mechanical breakdown, electrical arcing or short circuit, or the bursting or failure of pressure or vacuum equipment. Malfunction that does not cause physical damage, such as a software error or a need for adjustment, is not an “equipment breakdown”.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Definitions
clauses.text: “Covered equipment” means equipment owned by an “insured” and located on the “residence premises” that generates, transmits or uses energy, including heating, air conditioning and water heating systems; electrical service panels and wiring; built-in and household appliances; home electronics and computers; well pumps, sump pumps and standby generators. “Covered equipment” does not include “motor vehicles”, watercraft or “aircraft”; equipment used primarily in a “business”; buried or underground piping, wiring or service lines; or equipment owned by a utility.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Exclusions Changed
clauses.text: With respect to the coverage provided by this endorsement, the exclusion of loss caused by mechanical breakdown in paragraph 2.g.2 of Section I - Perils Insured Against, and the limitation in peril 15 of Coverage C excluding loss to tubes, transistors, electronic components or circuitry, do not apply.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Exclusions
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by wear and tear, rust, corrosion, erosion or gradual deterioration, unless it results in a sudden and accidental “equipment breakdown”, in which case we cover the loss caused by the breakdown but not the cost to correct the wear, rust, corrosion, erosion or deterioration itself. We do not cover loss caused by a test of the equipment, or by any cause excluded in Section I - Exclusions.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Limit and Deductible
clauses.text: The most we will pay for all loss arising out of any one “equipment breakdown” is $50,000. A deductible of $500 applies to each “equipment breakdown” in place of the Section I deductible. This coverage is additional insurance and does not reduce the limits of liability for Coverages A, B and C.

clauses.heading: Equipment Breakdown > Spoilage
clauses.text: We will pay up to $500 for spoilage of food in a refrigerator or freezer on the “residence premises” resulting from an “equipment breakdown” of the refrigerator or freezer, or of the electrical system supplying it.
